atoms.text: The wet autumn of 2000 was the wettest on record in England, Wales and Northern Ireland at the time. The record rainfall caused lots of flooding across the country. The worst flooding occurred in mid-October and continued into November.

atoms.a: In which countries was autumn 2000 the wettest on record?
b: England, Wales, Northern Ireland and Scotland

atoms.a: What was the cause of the flood?

atoms.text: As the rain kept falling, rivers rose and burst their banks. As well as the floods, there were gale-force winds at the end of October which damaged trees and buildings.

hint.text: Gale-force is the adjective we use to describe these really strong winds.
hint.label: Gale-force
